All modules

cal

components · 0.4.0 · H2 · aj-c-cal

The calendar inside Timeline's date and mood card (v4 C1): a month and year wheel beside one month's days, Monday first, the days marked by mood. A day written is a link; a day with nothing is a plain number, no tap target.

statedefaultyes: as rendered
statehovern/a: no hover treatment; a day link has the base link treatment
statefocus-visibleyes: the product focus ring on a day link (base)
stateactiveyes: a day written presses 1px down
statedisabledn/a: an empty day is not a control
stateselectedyes: selected month (aria-selected, --ink, semibold, centred between the wheel's two hairlines) and its current day (ringed)
stateloadingn/a: the months are drawn from known dates
stateerrorn/a: nothing here can fail
stateemptyyes: a month with nothing written is all plain numbers, with the note under its grid
